sections.Profile:
"Carnival" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in June 1948. The game features two flippers and a carnival-themed playfield, capturing the festive atmosphere of a traditional carnival.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Good Times, Wood Rail, Carnival, Circus, Original Theme, Festival
